description: The laboratory department group lists its first test twice with the same date, code and charge. Both lines were also paid by Medicare, so the group subtotal, total charges and balance due all include the duplicate. A reviewer should flag the second line.

sources.what: Detection of duplicate claims (exact and suspect duplicates)
sources.source: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 1 §120, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c01.pdf
